raw_text:
Demo budget app: ASP.NET Core 10 minimal API/EF Core; React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind; Docker Compose. Prefer simple, readable, composable code; clear names, not generic Repository/Service/Manager. Avoid using comments to overexplain everything. No code comments - use descriptive method/class names instead.

API `src/BudgetTracker.Api/`: feature-based (`Auth/`, `AntiForgery/`), `Program.cs`; Identity cookies + Static API keys (`StaticApiKeysConfiguration`); conditional anti-forgery; enforce user isolation at database query level. Web `src/BudgetTracker.Web/`: React Router v7, strict TypeScript, Axios; registration/login/logout, anti-forgery, tenant isolation, CSV auto-detection, Azure OpenAI insights/recommendations, pgvector semantic search, background recommendations, NLP query assistance.

.NET 10 nullable enabled; PostgreSQL: `Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=budgettracker;Username=budgetuser;Password=budgetpass123`. API http://localhost:5295; frontend http://localhost:5173; Swagger http://localhost:5295/swagger; CORS ports 5295/5173.

Microsoft Testing Platform (not VSTest); snake_case tests (`Should_do_when_something`); Testcontainers; prefer NSubstitute.

`dotnet watch run`
`dotnet run -p tests/BudgetTracker.Api.Tests --output detailed --filter-query "/path/to/test"`
`dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName`
`dotnet ef database update`
`npm run dev`
`npm run build`
`npm run lint`
`docker compose up -d`
`docker compose down`

When one of the applications is started for testing, make sure it's stopped once finished.
